E0766

A parameter with no default received no argument (D-APILABEL1)

What

A parameter with no default received no argument (D-APILABEL1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0766

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0766: tests/ui/arg_label_missing.stderr.

Error [E0766]: this call to `connect` is missing `port`
  --> tests/ui/arg_label_missing.jet:3:17
    |
  3 | fn run() { _ :: connect("db.internal", tls: false) }
    |                 ^^^^^^^
 Why: `port` has no default, so every call has to supply it
 Fix: add `port: …` to the call
